findings.text: `resolvedStepOutput_query_hasRows_of_clean_from` remains as a wrapper around the new equivalence solely for its existing caller in `TwoStateNotExistsExceptOutput.lean`. Fix: Apply the sufficient direction of `resolvedStepOutput_calm_hasRows` in that caller and delete the wrapper.

The catch-all in `Expr.isLogical` silently classifies every future expression constructor as false. Fix: List the constructors that return false explicitly so that Lean requires a decision for each new constructor.

The docstring says rejected expressions can produce any value, although a counter expression can produce only an integer or NULL and even the literal `1` is rejected. Fix: Describe the check as recognizing the listed outer constructors and state that a false result gives no conclusion about the evaluated value.

The module says every compound SELECT keeps one representative per equality class, although `UNION ALL` preserves duplicates and `UNION` compares rows across both terms. Fix: Describe the theorem’s guarantee for one projected row list and its use to establish representative identity for the left term of `EXCEPT`.

The module says the frame proof uses the same laws as the effect proof, but `purge_keeps_rows` in this commit still calls `resolvedStepOutput_notExistsExcept_hasRows`. Fix: Remove the last sentence until the frame proof uses the listed laws.

The status says `Query.simple_subqueryRun` excludes joins, although its `sources` argument accepts joined sources whenever the source and expression premises hold. Fix: Remove joins from the list of exclusions.

The status omits the separate `Table.RowsAliased` premise, so it claims output identity even for a table whose first-column values disagree with its stored rowids. Fix: State that every row must store its rowid in the alias column.

The status says `equalRowsIdentical_rowidFirst` has replaced `notExistsExcept_identical`, although `purge_keeps_rows` still calls the latter in this commit. Fix: Record that the general law is available and that migration of the frame proof is pending.

The status records passing host-check results although `AGENTS.md` permits status files to cite results only from Nix checks. Fix: Keep the names of the checks run and remove their local pass verdicts.
